description: Business days / working days calculator: count business days between two dates for one country, skipping weekends and public holidays, bank closures, or both (calendar: business, bank, combined). Returns the skipped dates with reasons.

calendar.description: business (default) skips national public holidays. bank skips bank closures: US Federal Reserve holidays, Danmarks Nationalbank closing days (DK), UK bank holidays (GB, or one nation GB-ENG, GB-WLS, GB-SCT, GB-NIR), and TARGET2 euro closing days. combined skips both. Other countries have no bank data, so bank and combined return an error for them.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or English country name. UK is accepted for the United Kingdom.

include_end.description: Count end when it is a working day. Default false.

include_start.description: Count start when it is a working day. Default false.

name: working_days_between

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

title: Working days between two dates
